title: 8 Microsegmentation Tools: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: Microsegmentation stops attackers moving sideways across networks . Once someone is inside your network through a phished credential, an unpatched server, or a compromised supplier flat internal networks let them reach everything. Microsegmentation puts a policy boundary around each workload so a single compromise stays a single compromise. We scored eight platforms and matched each to the environment it genuinely fits, because a VMware data centre and a Kubernetes estate need very different tools. Best Microsegmentation by Use Case — At a Glance Your situation Our pick Score Existing VMware virtualization estate VMware NSX (Broadcom) 8.4 Ransomware containment, mixed environments Illumio 8.8 Data centre and cloud, agentless preference Akamai Guardicore 8.6 Already on a zero-trust access platform Zscaler 8.0 Application dependency mapping on a budget Faddom 7.4 Regulated applications requiring application-level zero trust Airlock Microgateway 7.8 Mid-market wanting fast time-to-value ColorTokens 7.6 Campus, OT, and IoT segmentation Cisco 8.1 Definitional answer: microsegmentation applies granular security policy between individual workloads, applications, or devices inside a network, rather than only at the perimeter. It controls east-west traffic so that compromising one system does not give an attacker access to the systems around it.
